newsitem.title: UK: Northern Ireland Elec dips on Ofreg plan.
newsitem.headline: Northern Ireland Elec dips on Ofreg plan.

text.p: Shares in Northern Ireland Electricity Plc fell on Wednesday after industry regulator Ofreg said it would make the company cut its prices by more than earlier MMC proposals.

The stock fell 14p to 426p as the company considered whether to go to court over Ofreg's proposal to cut transmission and distribution prices by 29 percent in 1997/98 and by a further two percent a year thereafter.

The planned price cut was steeper than the 25 percent recommended by the Monopolies and Mergers Commission (MMC) earlier this year but more lenient than the 31 percent level Ofreg had previously proposed.

"This will cost NIE between 30 and 40 million stg - the difference between 25 and 29 percent over five years - and although the balance sheet could sustain it, it's a question of Ofreg refusing to accept the umpire's decision," said one utilities analyst.
